name: Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting (H-3DGS)
definition: A method for large-scale reconstruction that trains chunks independently and merges them into a global Level-of-Detail (LoD) hierarchy, addressing memory bottlenecks of standard 3DGS.
summary: Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting enables large-scale 3D reconstruction by training scene chunks independently and merging them into a global Level-of-Detail hierarchy to mitigate memory bottlenecks.
